'''January 2001 Pontiac tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Comic City, Pontiac, Michigan on 27 January 2001. It is known from Andrew Ehret's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1676">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-27-pontiac-michigan-1-27-01d1676/ pontiac-michigan-1-27-01], DeckTech (Andrew "Gwaihir" Ehret, 27 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-27-pontiac-michigan-1-27-01d1676/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 27 January 2001
* '''Site:''' Comic City, Pontiac, Michigan
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 9
